features.summary: Added deploy.py script for automated src/ → build/epci/ deployment with validation, version checking, exclusions, rollback on failure, and CLI options.
Added inline circuit breaker for ralph.sh. Detects stuck loops via file state hash (no-progress) and error hash (same-error) with 3-iteration threshold. Includes logging with timestamps.

Created ralph.sh.template for autonomous batch execution. Includes inline circuit breaker, RALPH_STATUS parser (<<<>>> delimiters), CLI flags (--quiet, --dry-run, --help), progress display with elapsed time, and timestamped logging. Supports MAX_ITERATIONS config and validates PRD v2 schema (userStories[]).

Created prd.json.template and memory.md.template, updated prompt.md.template with variable documentation. All templates follow {{VARIABLE}} placeholder format with inline $comment or HTML comment documentation.

Updated step-03-generate-ralph.md to use templates from task-005. Added PRD.json generation with userStories format, explicit template references (prd.json.template, memory.md.template, ralph.sh.template), circuit breaker mention, and correct section numbering (8 steps total).

Created ralph-registry-v1.json schema for .ralph/index.json feature registry. Defines feature entries with slug, title, status (ready/running/completed/paused/failed), complexity, paths (spec/ralph/prd), and stories_count. Step-03 already has registry update logic from task-006.

Created E2E test suite for Ralph integration. Tests all 5 ACs: spec generation (templates/schemas), ralph.sh structure (shebang, vars, claude invocation), status parsing (<<<>>> delimiters, RALPH_STATUS), circuit breaker (hash detection, threshold, exit codes), and PRD updates (userStories, execution). Includes minimal test-brief.md for validation.

Added agent team orchestration to /implement with step-03b-team.md for multi-domain parallel execution, --team/--no-team flags, parallel Code Reviewer, conditional Security/QA reviewers, and experimental Agent Teams support.
